subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work/PB389.md LANDED. GR9 -- 'a reference to the object identified by identifier-4 is placed into each data item referenced by identifier-3 in the order specified'. It was PARTIAL for two reasons and both are closed. (1) SR12 enumerates four alternatives for identifier-4 and the compiler could not EXPRESS two of them (an ACTIVE-CLASS reference and a FACTORY OF reference), so GR9 could never execute for those operands; the descriptor makes all four writable and EmitSetObjectRef renders the same reference copy for each. (2) The 'each ... in the order specified' half was pinned by no shipped test -- every existing golden had ONE receiver per statement. The golden now writes `SET B B2 TO D.` and invokes through BOTH, printing DERIVED twice; placing the reference into only the first receiver leaves B2 null and raises EC-OO-NULL.
